full_page.content:
1948, May 10
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
1948, May 10
Blessed be God in All His works:
God Bless you Mrs. Murray J. Turner, you and yours:
Many thanks for your favor of May 6th. It is rather hazey in my memory what your trouble was in December, since I get different cases often mixed.
However, I feel you are taking a practil way for any and every "hopeless" -- so called. We'll pray for your intention and try as best we can to foster confidence in God -- and in the intercession of our blessed Mother Mary.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
